column1: AA_NonCore Coverage - LAST UPDATED 2026-09-07 16:25. Rebuilt automatically every Friday by Coverage Manager (scheduled task WeeklyCoverageBuilder), immediately after the weekly performance run so prices and returns share one as-of date. 96 names: Sector (JP) in (Healthcare Services, MedTech), plus any row whose Subsector (JP) is Healthcare Real Estate. Price/market cap from Yahoo Finance that morning, FMP per row where Yahoo had no answer; market cap USD at spot FX, price in local currency. Returns are from the Coverage Manager performance snapshot built 2026-09-04. Size: LC at or above USD 25,000M, else SMID. Valuation columns state their basis in the heading: Fwd P/E (NTM) forward, EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA trailing twelve months. Rating is joined by ticker from Ratings_CoreCoverage.xlsx and is yours to edit - this build never writes it.
